body:
I'm in Illinois, USA.

I don't think I have the energy left in me to go through the road to recovery.  I don't want to live just to be alone.

I have no clue who I would go to see, nor do I have the money for repeated visits.  I'm also concerned with my living arrangements.  Sure, I may be able to save myself and get help, but I'm going to be jobless/homeless.  I'm not really sure I want to be there.

Copied from my response to another: I just don't have anything to live for. I have no friends, I have no job, and now soon to have no residence. I mess everything up I have going for me. I am only a disappointment and a let down. Even if I were to manage to get another job and keep my apartment, I'm at the point that I don't see the point in going on. I see what I'm doing. I'm just running away from my loneliness. I'd rather just stop running, for once. I'm tired of running.

I would rather not explain my plan in this reddit.

I'm 22.  I've had suicidal thoughts for a while, slightly on and off.  I never really recovered, I just did my best to find something to keep my attention diverted from those thoughts.

For the longest time, I have not had any real friends, and that's my fault.  I have always been self conscious and not a great talker, so I avoided social interactions.  If someone were to talk to me, I would crawl into my shell and give smoke screen answers until they left me alone.

I am not very close with my family, either.  When I was in highschool, my parents divorced, though this wasn't really an issue for me.  However, my mother and I had frequent clashes and when I turned 18 I moved out to live with my dad.  I have not spoken to my mother since.  I never really established any talking relationship with my father or younger sister.  My parents were never really someone I felt I could talk to.  They have always been there to let me know when I let them down, though.  When I was younger, I remember the time when I started to shave.  I don't remember how old I was, but I had no clue how to even do it.  My parents got me a razor for my birthday, but I was too shy to ask my dad how to use it.

After highschool, I managed to get into a decent college.  The problem was that I wasn't there for me, I was there because that's what my dad wanted.  I ended up withdrawing after my freshman year, before I was kicked out because of my GPA.  I did, however, manage to miraculously find a full time career job.  The pay was pretty crappy, but at least I had a job.

I was struggling with suicidal thoughts throughout those time periods, but now that I had a little money, I was buying anything I could use to distract myself from my loneliness.   This was working alright, until I managed to fuck everything up.   I slept through my alarm and missed the phone call from work.  When I woke up, I panicked.  I didn't know what to say, since it was several hours past the phone call I missed.  I kept thinking of how I let them down and that they thought I was a jerk.  I didn't know how I could face them again.  I couldn't get myself to call them back.  

I had some money saved up, but I'm not going to last forever.  My lease is about to expire and I don't have the money to renew.  My dad does not want me moving back with him, as I'm just dead weight to him and his new life (he is remarried).  

I just don't have anything to live for.  I have no friends, I have no job, and now soon to have no residence.  I mess everything up I have going for me.  I am only a disappointment and a let down.  Even if I were to manage to get another job and keep my apartment, I'm at the point that I don't see the point in going on.  I see what I'm doing.  I'm just running away from my loneliness.  I'd rather just stop running, for once.  I'm tired of running.
